title: Open Forge workspace settings
description: Authored workspace settings. A person writes and reviews this file; its generated counterpart is open-forge.lock.json. Unknown keys are accepted and ignored, so a file written for a newer release stays usable by an older one.

$schema.description: The schema describing this file. Used by editors for completion and validation; never fetched by the CLI.

schemaVersion.description: The shape this file was written for. A version the CLI does not recognise is read for the keys it understands and reported, never refused.

allowInstallPaths.description: Destinations outside .agents that the six permission-gated commands may write to: extension install, remove, and update, and library attach, detach, and sync. Entries are paths, not patterns. An entry naming a file admits that file; an entry naming a directory admits everything beneath it. There is no glob language, so what an entry admits is visible by reading it.

items.description: A workspace-relative path to a file or directory.

removedCategories.description: Root categories deliberately deleted from this workspace. Install and update do not reinstate them.
